beforeYouConnect: You need the Owner or Manager role in your Sentry organization: only those roles can edit the integration you will paste Frink's webhook address into.

actions.label: List Sentry issues
actions.description: Finds the issues in a Sentry organization — newest, unresolved, or matching what you describe.

actions.label: Search Sentry events
actions.description: Counts and lists the individual error events behind your issues.

actions.label: List Sentry projects
actions.description: Lists the projects in a Sentry organization.

actions.label: List Sentry organizations
actions.description: Lists the Sentry organizations you can see, with the slug other steps need.

actions.label: Look up a Sentry link
actions.description: Fetches whatever a Sentry URL points at — an issue, a project or a release.
